title: A Bing Crosby Family Christmas
description: A classic holiday special with Bing Crosby and his two sons. With very special guests Rich Little and Colt Luger’s Reid Harrison.
quote: Sometimes a snowman’s gotta do what a snowman does.
altHero: Bing Crosby dressed as a nutcracker, banging two drums on his two young sons’ heads
alt1: Reid Harrison dressed as a snowman
alt2: Rich Little, dressed as a reindeer, faces off with Harrison
alt4: Harrison frowning, holding a tree branch like a gun
